We’re entering a new era — the dawn of agentic commerce. At fabric, we believe the future of commerce isn’t just automated; it’s intelligent, adaptive, and human-centered. Agentic systems will change how businesses build, operate, and scale — not by replacing people, but by empowering them with the intelligence to act faster, smarter, and more intuitively than ever before.

Our mission: revolutionize commerce for everyone

Commerce powers the world, yet the systems behind it have remained static for too long. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to revolutionize commerce for everyone. We’re creating technology that bridges the gap between human intent and machine capability — enabling businesses to create experiences that respond dynamically to customer needs, in real time. We call it fabric NEON - building on our strengths and foundation as a commerce platform, and boldly evolving to meet the needs of today’s brands and retailers through intelligent workflows that get the job done.  

The first step: Product Agent

Our first breakthrough in agentic commerce is the Product Agent — an autonomous system that understands, optimizes, and manages the full lifecycle of products. From data enrichment to catalog management, pricing, and personalization, Product Agent acts as an intelligent collaborator for commerce teams. It learns from context, acts with precision, and continuously improves outcomes — so teams can focus on strategy and innovation, not manual maintenance.

The future of agentic commerce

fabric is building the foundation for a world where every commerce function — from product to pricing, logistics to marketing — becomes agentic. A world where systems think, decide, and act alongside humans. A world where commerce just works — fluid, intelligent, and adaptive.

This is a new way to commerce.

Company Description:
Founded in 2014 by Thibaud Hug de Larauze, Quentin Le Brouster, and Vianney Vaute, Back Market is a global marketplace for premium refurbished electronics. We’re here to help make refurbished tech trustworthy, reliable, and affordable. 

As a certified B-Corp, Back Market’s mission is to do more with what we already have. Because, well, what we already have is pretty great. That’s why all the tech you find on Back Market is better than new — because not only is it in perfect working condition, independent scientific research shows that refurbished electronics have a significantly smaller footprint on the environment than brand new. Every time someone chooses refurbished tech, we avoid additional environmental impact on the planet.

Of course, it’s not just about the tech sold by sellers on our marketplace, it’s also about how we run our business — we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to our own sustainability practices, too. We work across the refurbishment industry to develop new technologies, support environmental initiatives related to electronic waste (e-waste), and work with local governments across the globe to pass legislation that supports sustainability and the Right to Repair in the tech industry. 


We know we’re not alone in our vision for a world where tech respects the planet. With 884M€ raised to date and over 10 million customers around the world, we’re well on our way to the joyful revolution of Tech Reborn. 

Are you ready to join us? 

— 

Learn about the environmental impact of refurbished tech: https://www.backmarket.com/en-us/c/news/impact-of-refurbished-on-environment

Vanta is the #1 Agentic Trust Platform that helps businesses earn and prove trust. 

From startup to enterprise, Vanta is trusted by 15,000+ customers, including Atlassian, Duolingo, Icelandair, Ramp and Synthesia, to automate compliance, manage risk, and prove trust continuously—all from a single, AI-powered platform.

- Vanta AI: Supercharge your team with AI-powered control mapping, evidence checks, questionnaire automation, and custom code snippets to remediate failing tests. 

Founded in 2018, Vanta has customers in 58 countries with offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Sydney. Investors include Sequoia, Wellington, Craft Ventures, Y Combinator, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, J.P. Morgan, Atlassian Ventures and CrowdStrike Ventures.

Vanta has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Inc.’s Best Workplaces, and Forbes’ Best Startup Employer lists.

Founded in 2015 and built in Europe, Personio is the Intelligent HR Platform championing every side of HR's evolution.

As work becomes more complex and HR's role more strategic, most technology still treats HR as one-dimensional. We see it differently. Trusted by over 16,000 customers managing more than 1 million employees globally, Personio is built for everything HR has become. We support organisations of all sizes and industries, but specialise in global companies with between 200 and 5000 employees. 

We connect Core HR, Talent, and Payroll in one intelligent platform. Our platform eliminates manual work through automation, adapts to multi-entity complexity with flexible workflows, and transforms people data into strategic insights with AI.

Personio is built with deep European expertise, and we're the only HR platform with native payroll in Germany—Europe's most complex market. Plus we offer comprehensive apps to manage the entire employee lifecycle including recruiting, performance, compensation, and feedback. 

From implementation to everyday support, Personio is your partner from day one. We focus on the real challenges of HR and build with purposeful AI that amplifies the power of HR teams. 

We help organisations around the world unlock the power of their people.
